_lisezmoi: Elements combines chaque jour. Ajoutez a la fin des listes, ne changez jamais un id. Textes en anglais. Les reactions n'utilisent qu'UNE main libre : l'autre tient le telephone.

reactions.texte: She stares at her phone screen, slowly lowers the phone a little and just looks into the lens with a blank, stunned face.
She reads her screen, exhales a long slow breath through her mouth and slowly drops her forehead into her free hand.
She reads her screen, covers her mouth with her free hand, then slowly looks up into the lens with wide eyes.
She reads, closes her eyes, tilts her head back and lets out a long exasperated sigh.
She reads her screen, slowly shakes her head in disbelief and gives the camera a tired deadpan stare.
She glances at her screen, looks left and right as if checking nobody is around, then back into the lens with a guilty little smile.
She reads her screen, pulls back, reads again closer with squinted eyes, then looks into the lens in total disbelief.
She reads her screen, puffs her cheeks and blows out air slowly, eyebrows raised, completely overwhelmed.
She reads, slowly rubs her forehead with the fingertips of her free hand, eyes closed, as if what she just saw gave her a headache.
She reads her screen and bursts into a short shocked laugh, covers her mouth with her free hand, then looks into the lens still laughing in disbelief.
She reads, lets out a silent stunned laugh, rubs her forehead with her free hand and laughs again quietly, shaking her head.
She reads her screen and her jaw slowly drops, she stays frozen with her mouth open, then blinks twice at the lens.
She reads her screen and physically leans back away from the phone, eyebrows raised high, as if the screen scared her.
She reads her screen, a slow knowing smirk spreads on her face, she raises one eyebrow and looks into the lens as if sharing a secret.
She glances at her screen, then looks into the lens and slowly brings one finger of her free hand to her lips, with a small mischievous smile.
She reads her screen, presses her lips together to hold back a smile and nods slowly at the lens, impressed.
